# linenoise (vendored)

Line editing for `fccvis-shell`: history, completion, multi-line editing, and
the multiplexing API (`linenoiseEditStart`/`Feed`/`Hide`/`Show`) used to print
backend messages without corrupting the prompt.

- Source: https://github.com/antirez/linenoise
- Commit: a473823d74b93eab2ba83480df16ed37617493f2 (2026-05-02)
- License: BSD 2-clause (LICENSE in this directory)
- Local changes: none. Compiled as C with warnings relaxed (third-party code).
